name: Multiverse-Core
notes: Experimental release folia-1.21.11-18 (commit 4cc9e240, SHA-256 b6f1f5b4c2e8623a1ef028f69f77b423a2a5ceeb70cfa0bef9fce66097058b7b) passed 183 tests. On live Folia 1.21.11 build 14, `/mv create` succeeded through MoreFoWorld 1.13.4 but exceeded the 5-second global-region watchdog threshold. A copied disposable world passed `/mv import`, survived cold boot as UNLOADED, then `/mv load` completed in about 37 seconds and showed NORMAL. Test data was moved to rollback and original worlds.yml restored byte-for-byte. Player teleports, unload, portals, RTP, and cross-region behavior remain unverified.
